purpose: Define a separately reviewable, fixed, read-only collection contract for fresh remote identity and exact preimage evidence for the eleven WP-14 managed assets. This package does not implement or authorize the collector, contact the remote host, activate deployment, or authorize deployment or discovery.

required_local_controls: exact package and final collector hash verification before transport
closed no-argument invocation and fixed SSH argv
shared monotonic deadline with bounded concurrent stdout and stderr reads
single-operation lock and durable one-use claim before transport
strict host-key checking with no host-key acceptance fallback
closed JSON parsing with duplicate-key, depth, count and size rejection
secret and prohibited-content rejection before evidence persistence

evidence_schema.file_sha256_semantics: lowercase SHA-256 of exact remote bytes, never normalized text
evidence_schema.absent_semantics: sha256, mode, owner, file_type and hard_link_count are null; absence is checked at the exact fixed destination
forbidden_output: directory listings outside the eleven exact targets
PDK, OA, ADE-state, netlist, schematic, layout or waveform content

fail_closed_conditions: repository, package, deployer, collector or allowlist hash mismatch
repository identity or approved public visibility is unverified, or publication contains unchecked protected data
caller supplies an argument, path, command, environment override or design identifier
SSH host key, hostname, user or canonical remote root is unexpected or unverified
remote root or an existing target is symlinked, outside the fixed root or has an ambiguous canonical path
an existing target is not a regular file, is symlinked, has owner other than buet, has hard-link count other than one, or has mode outside 600 or 700
an asset is missing from or duplicated in the eleven-record output
a file hash is missing, zero, malformed or not computed over exact remote bytes
the result contains an unknown or extra field, prohibited content, invalid UTF-8, duplicate key, excessive nesting, excessive count or excessive bytes
timeout, nonempty stderr, nonzero transport exit, concurrent invocation or already-consumed claim
any attempted write, upload, snapshot, chmod, rename, cleanup, deployment, old-runner execution, Cadence start, discovery, simulation, OA/ADE/design/PDK access or retry
acceptance_criteria: AC-01: this artifact remains an approval request and every authority flag is false
AC-02: PR #26 exact reviewed head and merge commit are the repository baseline
AC-03: the immutable deployment package and hardened deployer hashes match the merged repository
AC-04: deployment_enabled remains false and no V2 authorization exists
AC-05: exactly eleven fixed managed assets are listed with fixed repository and remote-relative paths
AC-06: cadence-runner and runner-common require file presence; other assets may be file or absent but never unknown
AC-07: a future collector accepts no arguments and exposes no MCP, arbitrary shell, SSH, path or command interface
AC-08: a future collection uses only the fixed SSH alias, expected identity and fixed remote root
AC-09: a future collection is read-only and creates no remote temporary file, snapshot, backup or audit artifact
AC-10: no old runner, Cadence, SKILL, discovery, simulation or design interface is executed
AC-11: evidence includes exact hostname, user and canonical-root verification
AC-12: evidence contains exactly eleven preimages with exact-byte hash and observed metadata or explicit absence
AC-13: existing targets must be owned by buet, regular, non-symlink, one-link files with mode 600 or 700
AC-14: output is strict UTF-8, closed-schema, bounded to 32,768 bytes and rejects nonempty stderr
AC-15: one 60-second monotonic deadline, concurrency one, one attempt and no retry are enforced
AC-16: secrets, contents, unrelated listings and design or PDK data are neither collected nor persisted
AC-17: any identity, preimage, schema, bound or transport uncertainty yields a blocker rather than an inferred value
AC-18: the collected evidence is not itself deployment authority and cannot create or activate Authorization V2
AC-19: future V2 authorization requires separate review of the exact evidence hash and exact final deployer hash
AC-20: this package causes no remote contact, repository implementation, deployment, authorization, Cadence action or WP-15 work

review_decision_fields.notes: Approval of repository-only implementation does not authorize SSH or evidence collection. Approval of one collection does not authorize deployment, Authorization V2 creation, discovery invocation, or scientific baseline approval.

next_gate: Review and merge this request package. If accepted, separately authorize only repository-side implementation and isolated fake-transport testing of the fixed collector. Actual SSH evidence collection remains a later exact-hash single-use approval, and deployment remains later still.
